details.cardSet: Combined Set "Worldreaver's Descent & Dominion of Darkness"
details.effect: Necrocharge (10) - This follower has Rush and Bane. [fanfare] Choose one. (1) Select a Soulstrike in your cemetery and put it into your EX area. NC (20) - It costs 2 less to play this turn. (2) Bury the top 2 cards of your deck.

options.label: Select a Soulstrike in your cemetery and put it into your EX area
Bury the top 2 cards of your deck

issues: The Fanfare option to move Soulstrike from your cemetery to your EX area is missing the NC (20) rider. It should grant the selected Soulstrike card a play cost reduction of 2 this turn when Necrocharge (20) is active, e.g. use tutorFromCemetery with playCostReduction: 2 under a necrocharge 20 condition or wrap the option in a sequence/if.
